project.name: Queue status UI
project.brief: Allocate coherent pixel-art Working, Ready, Retry and Paused status assets for shared 16x16 queue cells while preserving the existing Start vector. Review a representative sample before family expansion; this allocation performs no asset generation.

included: Read BRIEF.md and SOURCE-MAP.md in full; re-read the changed brief, queue-state and queue-view source for this refresh.
Resolve the local ./queue type import and trace started/ok/error/pause through stateAfter to running/succeeded/failed/paused visual descriptors.
Trace both statusCell and compactStatus to the same statusVisuals map; allocate one shared asset per status rather than duplicate assets per consumer.
Inspect the only checked-in art, assets/start.svg, at source level for shape, dimensions and accent; verify the four current PNG destinations are absent.
Reconcile the Retry destination move to assets/error-retry.png while preserving its queue.retry ID and unchanged failure/retry purpose.
Capture unchanged display.cell, scale, nearest filtering, frameMs and dark-panel color from the supplied view descriptor.

Current refresh: re-read BRIEF.md line 9 and src/queue-view.ts; retain queue.ready ID while moving its destination to assets/ready-confirmed.png and promoting the explicitly required asymmetrical-arm check mark. Other states and Start unchanged.

Render stage: ran renderer/capture.mjs (HeadlessChrome 156, DPR 1) against the actual src/queue.ts and src/queue-view.ts for every statusVisuals state in both statusCell and compactStatus at 1x and 3x; checked identities, canvas pixels, alpha compositing and nearest blocks with renderer/check.py; inspected the retained PNGs visually.
excluded: Server-registry account badges returned by accountBadge are explicitly outside this local request; do not allocate replacement badge art.
No images are allocated for stateAfter or other functions without a visual role; the queue transitions determine status meaning only.
No new Start control, panel background, font, text label, host configuration, generated art or provider operation is assigned.
unresolved: The representative renderer in renderer/ is a scoped browser fixture that imports the real view modules; it is not the production UI, and its headless screenshot is laid out at the 1280 px window width while DOM bounds are measured at the 1262 px viewport, so renderer/check.py reports a 9 px horizontal offset (see queue.ready evidence). Production-host display acceptance remains unverified.

Style baseline: the delivered Ready fixture is a controlled pixellab-test sample (provider_simulated=true). Adopting it as the family style reference establishes edge treatment, stroke weight, fill/colour role, margin and alpha policy only; it does not establish the other members' silhouettes, motion or meaning, nor actual PixelLab output quality.
The account badge registry is populated remotely and is not enumerable from this checkout; badges remain excluded.

Working, Retry and Paused have no artwork, no production store, no candidate and no review; timed loop playback at 100 ms can only be observed interactively (node renderer/server.mjs) because the capture samples frame boundaries, not real-time playback.

value.scope: Family style baseline for Working, Retry and Paused: flat single cool-blue fill (#70b9ed as rendered), hard pixel edges with no anti-aliasing or outline, about 2 px perpendicular stroke (3-pixel runs on 45-degree diagonals; 2-pixel orthogonal strokes), no backing plate, transparent exterior, footprint about 11x9 within 2-3 px margins of the 16x16 cell. It does not prescribe the other members' silhouettes, motion or meaning and is not evidence of PixelLab-generated quality (provider_simulated=true).

requirements.reason: RENDER-STAGE.md lines 4-6 authorize the caller's scoped style decision for this representative consumer; this value records adoption of the exact delivered sample bytes as the approved reference the brief (line 5) said did not yet exist. requirements.name: geometry
requirements.check: Decoded image is exactly 16x16 pixels with a single static frame (no horizontal strip, no extra canvas).
requirements.reason: Decoded PNG is 16x16 with one static frame; no strip or extra canvas.

requirements.name: transparent-background
requirements.check: The background is transparent: pixels outside the subject have alpha 0 and no opaque matte, box or fringe fills the cell. Partial alpha on subject pixels is permitted; binary alpha is not required.
requirements.reason: 227 pixels are RGBA 0,0,0,0; 29 subject pixels are opaque blue. Transparent exterior and open corners have no matte or fringe; no binary-alpha rule imposed.

requirements.name: ready-meaning
requirements.check: Viewed alone, Ready visibly uses a check mark with asymmetrical arms to convey successful completion; it reads as completion rather than activity, failure, pause, or the idle Start control.
requirements.reason: Viewed native and 3x: a short descending left arm joins a distinctly longer ascending right arm into a clear check mark. It reads as successful completion rather than triangle, pause bars, loop or failure.

requirements.name: readability-1x-3x
requirements.check: Composited on #172336, the silhouette is readable at 1x and at 3x nearest-neighbor scale, with no essential detail lost into the panel colour.
requirements.reason: Native 16x16 panel composite shows a recognizable light-blue check; 48x48 nearest composite preserves clear steps and essential asymmetrical arms against #172336.

requirements.name: cool-blue-accent
requirements.check: The dominant colour treatment visibly relates to the existing UI's cool blue accent as seen in assets/start.svg (#70b9ed). This is a visual relationship judgement, not an exact-hex or palette-count rule.
requirements.reason: Visible sky-blue treatment relates directly to the preserved Start SVG's cool-blue cue; measured color happens to equal #70b9ed, but exact equality was not a rejection rule.

requirements.name: sample-pixel-craft
requirements.check: As a representative family sample, the image shows deliberate pixel-art construction: clean pixel clusters and edges, no noisy stray pixels, blur or downscaled-illustration artifacts, and a treatment that could plausibly be extended to Working, Retry and Paused.
requirements.reason: Viewed all native and enlarged views: compact connected stepped clusters form a crisp check without blur, isolated noise or downscaled illustration artifacts. A plausible sample for future family extension; family adoption and comparisons remain separate.

after_observation.succeeded: Retrieve the actual result and import it against this job's saved output plan; then review the candidate.
after_observation.failed: Retain the failure, compare the current contract and decide whether an explicit new request is needed.
after_observation.pending_or_unknown: Continue observation or reconciliation of the same attempt; retain its provider identity.
